# preprompt

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Renders everything equin appended to the agent's system prompt — the launch special instructions (preprompt) and every contributed section (mandate, page instructions, supervisor roles, task tree…) — as one Instructions card in the JSONL viewer, each part folding on its own.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `JsonlViewer.EventRenderer` "preprompt" → `PrepromptRow`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer.JsonlViewer`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/collapsible-card.CollapsibleCard`
    - `primitives/collapsible.Collapsible`
    - `primitives/collapsible.CollapsibleChevron`
    - `primitives/collapsible.CollapsibleContent`
    - `primitives/collapsible.CollapsibleTrigger`
    - `primitives/css/spacing.Stack`
    - `primitives/css/text.Text`
    - `ui/icons.Icon`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Uses tokens:
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --foreground`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --muted-foreground`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --primary`
    - `ui/tokens/color-palette --primary-text`
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-md`
    - `ui/tokens/density --space-xs`
    - `ui/tokens/shape --radius`
    - `ui/tokens/shape --spacing`
    - `ui/tokens/type-scale --font-scale`
    - `ui/tokens/type-scale --font-size-caption`
    - `ui/tokens/type-scale --font-weight-normal`
    - `ui/tokens/type-scale --line-height-caption`
